title: Period Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates the period T = 2.0 s from the given time to the second trough.

title: Wave Speed Determination
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly determines the wave speed using v = λ/T, with λ = 4 m from the diagram.

title: Time Delay to N
description: Important Criteria: Student calculates the time for the wave to travel from M to N using Δt = Δx/v, finding Δt = 3.5 s.

title: N's Vibration Time
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly finds the time particle N has been vibrating by subtracting the delay from the total time (10 s - Δt = 6.5 s).

title: Particle Distance Formula
description: Important Criteria: Student applies the correct relationship s = 4A × n for total distance traveled by a particle in SHM over n complete cycles plus partial cycles.

title: Final Distance Answer
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates the total distance traveled by particle N as 26 cm (or 0.26 m).

title: Incorrect Trough Timing
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly relates the time to the second trough (e.g., using t₁ = T or t₁ = 2T) leading to a wrong period.

title: Confusing Distance with Displacement
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student calculates the net displacement (which is zero after complete cycles) instead of the total path length traveled by particle N.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student maintains consistent units throughout (e.g., converting cm to m appropriately) and includes units in final answers.
